integrity: Analytic proof with supplementary deterministic finite checker; all equality and asymptotic assertions in RESULT.md derive from the written proof, not merely numerical tests.
scientific_limitations: Only fixed alpha>1, 2-to-4 exponents, and carrier packets of width L_m log(m)=o(m); no sharp finite-degree closed formula, no broader bandwidth or other exponent cases established. Historical novelty remains best-knowledge and no independent validation has occurred.
title: Carrier–bandwidth law for sharp weighted Bergman hypercontractive cutoffs
